risk: Part data / volumes wrong or missing
mitigation: Questionnaire signed by owner, 5-year volume review gate P1
Interface sheets per module, signed; one integrator responsible

risk: Software (cell controller / MES) late or buggy
mitigation: Module library, virtual commissioning, early MES test system
Order early (letter of intent), penalty clause, weekly supplier report
Ramp-up plan with weekly targets, supplier support on site in contract
Test cut before order, guaranteed time in contract, time study at FAT
Contingency 10-15 %, change-order process, monthly cost report
Risk assessment from P3, safety engineer reviews at 30/60/90 %
Involve operators from P2, training plan, super-users

risk: Network / IT security rules block integration
mitigation: IT department in P3, zone model agreed early (item 6)

risk: Fixture design not robot / pallet ready
mitigation: Fixture standard in URS, design review with pallet supplier
Site plan with dates, owner checklist, weekly site meeting
Deputy for each role, documentation in shared folder

risk: Tool magazine too small for unmanned shifts

mitigation: Financial check in tender, bank guarantees, escrow of source code
